name: Vrije Universiteit Brussel
summary: Dutch-speaking university in Brussels; three English-taught bachelor's: business economics, languages and literature, and social sciences with Ghent.

ib.text: The IB Diploma is on VUB's list of equivalent diplomas, so you are admitted directly. For English, send a school letter that English was the language of instruction, or IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL 79.

dates.label: Last day to apply with a foreign diploma if you need a student visa
Last day to apply with a foreign diploma and no visa needed (EEA)

programmes.name: Business Economics
programmes.about: Micro- and macroeconomics, maths and statistics alongside marketing, finance and management, taught in English in Brussels; in the final year you choose International Business or Business and Technology.
programmes.ib: Majors: Business and Technology, or International Business. VUB expects maths throughout secondary school; an optional online maths self-test is offered.
programmes.selectionNote: The IB gives direct admission and there is no cap. VUB expects maths throughout school and looks at it closely; its maths self-test is optional and not binding.

programmes.name: Linguistics and Literary Studies
programmes.about: Linguistics and literature across up to seven languages: you pick two major languages and up to two more, with courses in language skills, writing and analysis, in multilingual Brussels.
programmes.ib: Choose two major languages; Dutch as a major needs C1 and French B2 before you start. Mandatory short online interview.
programmes.selectionNote: A 15–20 minute online interview on your background and motivation, then a review of your file. Dutch as a major needs C1 and French B2; German, Italian and Spanish need none.

programmes.name: Social Sciences (with Ghent University)
programmes.about: Sociology, political science and communication studies taught together around real problems, with research methods from statistics to interviews and participant observation; you study in Brussels and Ghent and hold student cards for both.
programmes.ib: Joint with Ghent University: year 1 mostly in Brussels, later years partly in Ghent. Major in political science, communication studies or sociology in year 3.
programmes.selectionNote: The IB gives direct admission and there is no cap. Solid maths from school is expected; an optional online self-test lets you check your level.

notes: VUB's Dutch-taught bachelor's need proof of Dutch, such as an ITNA or CNaVT certificate at B2.
The Brussels School of Governance, an alliance with VUB's Institute for European Studies, awards its English BAs as Vesalius College degrees; they are on that page.
